how_to_apply: Eligible permanent residents of Chhattisgarh can submit online applications for the 69 non-teaching vacancies through the SMKV Bastar recruitment portal from 16 October to 4 November 2026.
Visit the official university website at www.smkvbastar.ac.in.
Open Career → Recruitment Portal → Applicant Login → New Registration.
Complete the online registration with the required details.
Receive the User ID and Password through the registered mobile number.
Return to Applicant Login and sign in using the registered credentials.
Select Advertisement No. 3660/2026, 3662/2026 or 3666/2026 according to the position.
Enter the requested personal information and save the details.
Enter typing certificate details where applicable to DEO, Assistant Grade-3 or Store Keeper.
Upload the relevant educational, domicile, caste, computer qualification, experience and other prescribed certificates.
Upload a recent colour passport-size photograph and signature according to the notified size requirement of 30 KB to 100 KB.
Review all information through Preview and Confirm.
Select Proceed to Payment and pay the applicable application fee.
Complete the application submission and retain a printout for future use.

Important: The three advertisements must be selected separately in the application portal. Candidates should verify the eligibility, fee and submission requirements for their chosen post before proceeding.

content_sections.heading: SMKV Bastar Vacancy 2026 Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: The university has announced 69 vacancies under three recruitment notices. The largest individual post category is Peon with 23 vacancies, followed by Assistant Grade-3 with 21 posts. The remaining 25 vacancies cover Data Entry Operator, Store Keeper and technical or laboratory-related positions.

content_sections.heading: SMKV Bastar Assistant Grade 3, DEO and Store Keeper Vacancy 2026
SMKV Bastar Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification Cut-off: The required educational and other eligibility qualifications must be completed by 4 November 2026. Candidates applying for the 23 Peon vacancies must have passed Class 10 from a recognized board or institution. The notification does not prescribe a computer diploma or typing certificate for Peon. Applicants for Data Entry Operator, Assistant Grade-3 and Store Keeper must possess graduation or the prescribed Class 12 plus Modern Office Management (MOM) Diploma qualification. A one-year computer diploma and the applicable typing certificate are additionally required. Applicants for Technical Assistant and Research Assistant must have at least two years of experience in an equivalent position at a recognized institution, along with the relevant postgraduate qualification. Experience must be supported by the prescribed certificate.

content_sections.heading: SMKV Bastar Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the combined SMKV Bastar non-teaching vacancies includes an OMR-based written examination, skill or practical examination and preparation of a final merit list. The number of written examination questions differs for Peon compared with the other posts. Written Examination: Objective-type test of 100 marks for Peon or 120 marks for Group C posts. Skill / Practical Examination: Candidates shortlisted on written-test merit must appear for the relevant practical assessment carrying 30 marks. Experience Evaluation: Eligible SMKV Bastar daily-wage experience may contribute up to 10 marks. Final Merit List: Prepared out of 100 marks after converting the written examination score and adding applicable practical and experience marks. Document Verification: Verification of educational, domicile, category and other prescribed certificates.

content_sections.heading: SMKV Bastar Skill Test and Final Merit Calculation 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must secure at least 30% marks in the written examination. Based on written-test merit, up to 10 candidates per vacancy will be shortlisted for the skill or practical examination. The practical examination carries 30 marks, and candidates must obtain at least 50% of those marks to qualify. For Technical and Clerical Posts: Written merit marks = (Marks obtained out of 120 / 120) × 60. For Peon: Written merit marks = (Marks obtained out of 100 / 100) × 60. The 10 experience marks are specifically for eligible daily-wage work experience at SMKV Bastar under the prescribed recruitment rules. They are not automatically awarded for general experience at other institutions.

content_sections.text: Indian History, Geography and Constitution. General Science and Environment. History, Geography and Culture of Chhattisgarh. Chhattisgarh Tribes, Economy and Administration. Current Affairs of India and Chhattisgarh. Local Government and Panchayati Raj. Vocabulary, Synonyms and Antonyms. Sandhi, Samas, Prefixes and Suffixes. Sentence Correction. Idioms and Proverbs. Hindi Grammar and Comprehension. Reading Comprehension. Grammar and Vocabulary. Synonyms and Antonyms. Tenses and Prepositions. Sentence Correction. Active and Passive Voice. Basic Numerical Ability. Logical and Analytical Reasoning. Decision Making and Problem Solving. Data Interpretation. General Mental Ability. Computer Fundamentals. Input and Output Devices. Operating Systems. MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Internet and Email. Computer Viruses and Antivirus Software. Search Engines and Multimedia. Artificial Intelligence Basics. For technical posts, the relevant subject section carries 80 marks. The official syllabus covers the subjects corresponding to Statistics, Psychology, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Geology, Zoology, Botany, Microbiology, Geography, Commerce, Education and Library and Information Science.

content_sections.heading: SMKV Bastar Examination Centres 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must select two preferred examination districts when completing the online application. The university will allot an examination centre according to its recruitment arrangements. The skill or practical examinations for shortlisted candidates will be conducted at the SMKV Bastar campus. Examination dates and venue details will be published on the university website.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for SMKV Bastar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible permanent residents of Chhattisgarh can submit online applications for the 69 non-teaching vacancies through the SMKV Bastar recruitment portal from 16 October to 4 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: SMKV Bastar Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: SMKV Bastar will allow corrections to permitted application details from 5 November to 7 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM . Applicants changing their reservation category from a lower-fee reserved category to Unreserved must pay the applicable fee difference. A reverse category change will not result in a refund of the excess amount paid.

content_sections.heading: SMKV Bastar Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the relevant certificates during application and produce original documents when called for verification.
